english.title: Fish in Newton's Cove
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) fished in Newton’s Cove

(A)_[by trawl or dredges, west of a line drawn due north from “C” Head to the northern limit of Portland Harbour]_
(B)_[by nets west of a line drawn 026 degree (true) from Torpedo Pier Light to the northern limit of Portland Harbour]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraphs 43(3) and 60(1)(b) of Part V of Schedule 1 to the Portland Harbour Revision Order 1997.
